name: How long does it take to remove smoke smell from walls?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove smoke smell from walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of smoke odor removal depends on the severity of the smoke damage, the size of the affected area, and the type of materials involved. Mild cases might take a few days, including cleaning and air treatment. More severe damage, especially when materials need to be removed and replaced, can extend the process to several weeks. A professional assessment provides a more accurate timeline based on your specific situation. Our team works efficiently to restore your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies from a few days for mild cases to several weeks for severe damage, depending on the extent and materials involved.
